newsitem.title: USA: Hartford Steam Boiler Q1 net down.
newsitem.headline: Hartford Steam Boiler Q1 net down.

text.p: (All data above 000s except per share numbers)
NOTE: Income excluding realized investment gains was $0.76 a share compared with $0.81 a year ago.
Income excluding realized gains and Radian International LLC results was $0.76 a share compared with $0.68 a year ago.
The First Call Consensus was $0.80 a share.
The combined ratio was 90 percent, down from 91 percent a year ago.
The operating gain from insurance operations was up 30 percent and engineering services revenue rose 15.2 percent.
Insurance premiums were $122.3 million compared with $108.4 million a year ago.
